meta_title: REKKI Alternative for Food Distributors in 2026
meta_desc: Keep REKKI's AI and add an app your accounts speak orders into, confirming every line first. A REKKI alternative that leaves fewer messages to figure out.

hero.h1: Need A REKKI Alternative? Try Spoken, Checked Orders.
hero.lead: Receive orders already checked by the person who placed them. VoiceOrder Solutions works alongside REKKI's AI: your customer speaks into our app, picks items from their own guide, and looks over every line before it goes. REKKI's AI keeps reading whatever still arrives as an email or message.

problem.h2: Why distributors weigh an alternative to REKKI
problem.lead: People hunting for a REKKI competitor rarely doubt REKKI's AI. Their worry is usually about the orders it has to read, and that can be fixed with REKKI's tools left running.

cards.h3: Reading orders by software has an error rate
cards.body: REKKI publishes its error rate. There is a rate because software is working out what each order said, and REKKI backs it with double checks and a refund guarantee. When the customer builds the order from a guide and reviews it first, nobody has to piece it together from a message later.

Their site says your team trains it to fit your business, and that it starts processing orders and learning right away. That gives you real control. With our app, we set up every account from the order guides you already have.

Software that reads a sloppy message well stays busy, because those messages keep coming. For some accounts, you would rather they stopped sending messages entirely. Our app can take those accounts while REKKI handles the rest.

cards.h2: Where REKKI's AI and VoiceOrder Solutions each fit
cards.lead: Keeping both makes sense. Our app is not a REKKI replacement: it moves some of your accounts off sending messages at all. Whatever comes in as an email or a voicemail still needs something to read it. A REKKI alternative often turns out to mean exactly that.

items.h3: A smaller pile for REKKI to read
items.body: Kitchens on the app hand over a checked list rather than a message. Whatever reads the rest has less to work through.

items.h3: Keep whatever brings you new buyers
items.body: Anything that finds you customers should keep doing it. We have no marketplace and do not help you find buyers. We only handle the ordering once they are your customers.

items.h3: Begin with the kitchens that phone most
items.body: Nothing else has to change for it, so start with the few accounts that take up most of your morning, and judge it on those.

faq.h2: Better than REKKI, or something to use beside it?

items.q: Is VoiceOrder Solutions a REKKI alternative, or something to add?
items.a: One to add, not swap. REKKI automates the work your office does on orders that have already arrived, plus the inbox and the upselling. We change the way one group of customers orders, so less of that work exists. REKKI's tools can stay on the rest.

items.q: Is the voice app more accurate than REKKI?
items.a: We don't claim a better percentage. Our safeguard is different: every line is picked from the account's guide, and the customer checks each one before sending. REKKI's number measures how well a machine reads an order a person wrote. Ours is a different kind of check, not a higher score.

items.q: So can an order still be wrong?
items.a: Of course. Somebody can confirm the wrong quantity, as they can on any order ever placed. What changes is who reads the lines last: the person who wants the goods, before anything leaves. This only covers orders placed in our app: a call or a voicemail to your desk gets no number, no timestamp and no stock update.

items.q: Does your app connect to REKKI?
items.a: No. There is no link between the two and no joint support. REKKI's OrderAI, their order-reading software, keeps passing what it reads into your system, and our orders come separately, emailed as a file or sent in over EDI or the API.

items.q: Some of our customers already use the REKKI app. What happens?
items.a: Nothing breaks. REKKI's chef app is free. REKKI says it sends orders to suppliers even if the supplier has not joined REKKI, by turning them into emails to your order address. Those keep arriving as they do now. Give our app to the accounts who prefer speaking to typing, and leave the ones already happy where they are.

They are more open about price than we are, and that deserves saying: their site shows a starting price per customer and what it includes. The price is in pounds. Their marketplace is described as UK only, but the app is described as working anywhere in the world. Ours is quote-based and nothing is published, so ask and you will get a figure for the voice step on its own.

items.q: How fast could this be running?
items.a: Most distributors are running it in 24 to 48 hours, and most kitchens place a first order the same day. Nothing in REKKI is touched or rewired, which matters if you came looking for a REKKI alternative with only one problem to settle.

items.q: Where do the REKKI details on this page come from?
items.a: Taken from rekki.com, as of 10 October 2026: the AI tool descriptions, the accuracy and training wording, the published starting price and the chef app questions. Their performance figures are their own and are not quoted here as results. If any of it has moved on, the mistake is at our end.
